what: baseline (s9 reference path, workers=1) vs optimised (core.* backends, workers=4), manifest tuning126, both cold, dev_mode empty
excluded_from_comparison: wall (per-target wall seconds -- the quantity being optimised; differs on 126/126 by design)

aggregate_deviations.mechanism: PROVEN, not assumed: every per-target input to these aggregates is bit-identical, so the only remaining free variable is the order of accumulation across 4 workers. Fix is to reduce in canonical pdb order.
aggregate_deviations.tolerance: 1-2 ulp of float64 (<=4e-16 relative) on aggregate statistics only

headline.note: The four-component arm is NOT a speedup figure: core/bench.py refuses --components on the baseline arm because s9/final.py contains no VQE and no Legacy stage, so it has no baseline counterpart. It is reported as an absolute cost with its ablations (see FINDINGS S11-1).
